name: Chat Floating Button BY XD
author: 希扎尔 (Xī zhā ěr)

sections.description:
Chat Floating Button BY XD adds a beautiful, customizable floating WhatsApp button to your WordPress website. Help visitors contact you instantly with one click!

Core Features

  • ✅ Floating WhatsApp button
  • ✅ Left/Right position control
  • ✅ Hide on mobile/desktop devices
  • ✅ Custom tooltip with text
  • ✅ Default message support
  • ✅ Fully responsive design
  • ✅ Lightweight & fast loading
  • ✅ Shortcode support
  • ✅ WooCommerce compatible

Premium Features

Unlock advanced features with a premium license:

  • 🎨 Button Size Options – Small, Medium, Large
  • 🎨 Custom Colors & Gradients – Match your brand
  • 🎨 Button Animations – Pulse, Shake, Bounce
  • ⏱️ Display Delay – Show button after X seconds
  • 🎯 Page Targeting – Show on specific pages
  • 👥 User Role Visibility – Show to logged-in users only
  • 📅 Time Scheduling – Business hours only
  • 📊 Analytics Dashboard – Track button clicks
  • 🔔 Email Notifications – Get alerts on clicks
  • 🔗 Webhook Integration – Connect to Zapier, Make
  • 👑 Priority Support – Fast response

License Plans

Free Version
– All core features
– 1 website
– Community support
– Price: Free

Professional License ($39/year)
– All premium features
– 5 websites
– Priority email support
– 1 year updates

Premium License ($99/year)
– All premium features
– Unlimited websites
– 24/7 priority support
– Lifetime updates

Why Upgrade?

  • Increase WhatsApp conversations by 40%+
  • Better targeting options
  • Analytics to track performance
  • Priority support
  • Regular updates

Easy Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to WhatsApp Chat menu
  3. Enter your WhatsApp number (e.g., +923001234567)
  4. Customize button appearance
  5. Save settings – done!

Shortcode Usage

Place button anywhere using shortcode:
[cfbxd_whatsapp_button]

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Support

Email: muhammadalikhizar@gmail.com
Facebook: https://facebook.com/xpertdezineit

Credits

Developed by Muhammad Ali Khizar & Xpert Dezine IT
sections.installation:
1. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/chat-floating-button-by-xd/
  2. Activate through ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Navigate to WhatsApp Chat settings
  4. Enter WhatsApp number with country code
  5. Customize and save
sections.faq:
What number format should I use?

Use country code format: +923001234567

Can I use on multiple websites?

  • Free: 1 website
  • Professional: 5 websites
  • Premium: Unlimited websites

How to get premium features?

Click “Upgrade to PRO” in plugin settings

Is there a money-back guarantee?

Yes, 14-day money-back guarantee

How do I get support?

  • Free: WordPress forums
  • Premium: Email support
